projects.name: AtlasOS
projects.summary: A Windows 11 configuration project that applies the Atlas Playbook through Atlas Manager.
projects.approach: Start from a fresh, supported Windows 11 installation and follow the official Atlas Manager guide.
projects.caution: Atlas changes Windows settings and removes components. Back up files first and review the current security and compatibility guidance.

projects.name: ReviOS
projects.summary: A privacy- and performance-focused Windows playbook delivered through the open-source AME Wizard.
projects.approach: Use the official guide to apply the playbook to an existing Windows install or inject it into a stock Windows ISO.
projects.caution: This makes system-wide changes. Review each step, create backups, and use only a clean Windows image from Microsoft.

projects.name: Tiny11 Builder
projects.summary: An open-source utility for building a smaller customized Windows 11 image from a clean Microsoft ISO.
projects.approach: Download the builder from its official repository and provide your own Microsoft Windows 11 ISO.
projects.caution: Removing Windows components can affect features and updates. Read the project documentation and test the resulting image before using it on a primary PC.

projects.name: Chris Titus Tech WinUtil
projects.summary: A community Windows setup and maintenance utility for installing apps and applying configuration, tweak, and repair options.
projects.approach: Review the selected options in the official project before applying them; use its documentation for supported Windows releases.
projects.caution: Some actions modify system configuration or remove bundled apps. Review selections and create a restore point first.

projects.name: Win11Debloat
projects.summary: An open-source PowerShell script for removing unwanted apps and adjusting Windows privacy and interface settings.
projects.approach: Read the script options and run only the actions you want from the official repository.
projects.caution: PowerShell changes can remove apps or alter settings. Review the script and its current Windows compatibility notes before running it.

projects.name: Sophia Script
projects.summary: A modular PowerShell customization project with documented Windows privacy and usability settings.
projects.approach: Use the official documentation to select and review individual script functions.
projects.caution: This is an advanced script toolkit. Understand each selected function and keep a backup before applying system changes.

projects.name: Winhance
projects.summary: An open-source Windows app for configuring, customizing, and debloating Windows installations.
projects.approach: Use the official repository for current releases, supported versions, and installation instructions.
projects.caution: Debloat and system configuration actions may affect installed apps or Windows features. Review changes before applying them.

projects.name: BloatyNosy
projects.summary: An open-source Windows 11 debloat and configuration utility from Builtbybel.
projects.approach: Check the official repository for the latest project status and supported installation method.
projects.caution: Debloating can remove apps or disable features. Create a restore point and review each proposed change.

projects.name: O&O ShutUp10++
projects.summary: A Windows privacy configuration utility with documented controls for Windows 10 and Windows 11.
projects.approach: Review the available privacy recommendations and use the official O&O download and documentation.
projects.caution: Privacy settings can affect Windows services and app behavior. Review each recommendation and export settings before changing them.

projects.name: Winaero Tweaker
projects.summary: A Windows interface and behavior customization utility maintained by Winaero.
projects.approach: Use the official product page for compatibility notes and downloads.
projects.caution: Some tweaks change system or user settings. Review each option and use the built-in reset or backup guidance when available.
